objective: Replace the C018 zero-gain linear-motion bypass with a bounded non-blind deblurring route while retaining exact fallback when development gates fail.

supersedes.reason: The initial three-crop code exercise wrote to the official development output namespace. It was not an official development result. v1a separates every max-crops exercise into runs/smoke and reserves runs/development_v1/motion_scan.json for the complete 50-crop, 33-parent scan.

reserved_confirmation_bank.access_rule: Do not evaluate the C061 route until the route, parameters, code, and confirmation gates are frozen.

scientific_boundary.development: Only the C006 synthetic_holdout split (50 crops, 33 physical parents) is used to select an algorithm and parameters.
scientific_boundary.confirmation: The C010 98-crop, 68-parent cohort is not evaluated until the route and gates are frozen.
scientific_boundary.operator: The synthetic linear-motion kernel length and angle are supplied to the route; this is not blind field-PSF estimation.
scientific_boundary.field: A positive synthetic result does not establish real-tunnel motion deblurring.

execution_contract.smoke_scan: Any run with --max-crops is a code exercise written only under runs/smoke and cannot support selection or a manuscript claim.
execution_contract.selection_timing: Inspect and select only after all 50 crops and all 128 candidates for each of the three severities are complete.

selection: Within each severity, select the eligible configuration with maximum parent-mean PSNR improvement. Prefer one shared algorithm family across severities; severity-specific regularization is allowed because kernel parameters are supplied.
